content:
name: EOS evidence refresh

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      targets:
        description: "Space-separated EOS targets to revalidate"
        required: true
        default: "WP-MVP-0001 WP-MVP-0002 WP-MVP-0003 WP-MVP-0004"
      profile:
        description: "EOS validation profile"
        required: true
        default: "wp"
  push:
    branches:
      - "fix/eos-*"
    paths:
      - ".eos/refresh-evidence.trigger"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: eos-evidence-refresh-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  refresh:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EOS_ACTOR: eos-evidence-refresh
      TARGETS: ${{ inputs.targets || 'WP-MVP-0001 WP-MVP-0002 WP-MVP-0003 WP-MVP-0004' }}
      PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile || 'wp' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Refresh governed evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          for target in $TARGETS; do
            ./scripts/eos validate "$target" --profile "$PROFILE"
          done

      - name: Regenerate trace before machine projection
        run: python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write

      - name: Regenerate machine documents from settled trace
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify refreshed governed state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Commit refreshed evidence and projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git add .eos engineering/evidence machine
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            echo "Unexpected unstaged changes outside governed evidence/projection paths:" >&2
            git status --short >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "chore(eos): refresh stale verification evidence"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
